responsibility: This header defines the `thunderx3t110_tunings` model for Marvell/Cavium ThunderX3 T110 in the AArch64 backend. It supplies ThunderX3-specific address costs, register-move costs, AdvSIMD vector costs, prefetch settings, issue rate, and fusion capabilities, allowing instruction costing and code-shape heuristics to track the newer ThunderX3 microarchitecture rather than earlier ThunderX generations.
same_name_distinction: This `thunderx3t110` file provides the tuning parameter bundle for ThunderX3 in `tuning_models/`, whereas the same-stem file `gcc/config/aarch64/thunderx3t110.md` is the scheduler machine description that encodes execution units, reservations, and latency behavior.
